# Primitives (25)

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @ballmac/<name>`. Import: `@/components/ballmac/<name>`. Names in parentheses are the exports.

- **accordion** (Accordion, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, AccordionContent): Vertically stacked disclosure sections on Radix Accordion, single or multiple open, with hairline dividers, a rotating plus and height animation. Not for: A single show/hide toggle (use reasoning-disclosure or a Radix Collapsible).
- **avatar** (Avatar, AvatarFallback, AvatarGroup, AvatarImage): A Radix avatar with image and initials fallback, three sizes, an optional presence dot, and AvatarGroup for overlapping stacks with a +N overflow counter. Not for: Logos or product icons (use an img).
- **badge** (Badge): A small pill label in four variants with an optional status dot and success, warning and error tones. Not for: Clickable filters that toggle (use a toggle or button).
- **button** (Button): A button with six variants, three sizes, a pill shape and a built-in loading state. Not for: Navigation inside running text (use a link).
- **button-group** (ButtonGroup, ButtonGroupText, ButtonGroupSeparator): Join adjacent actions into one compact control surface while retaining each button's visible keyboard focus and accessible name. Not for: Mutually exclusive options; use toggle-group.
- **checkbox** (Checkbox): A Radix checkbox with checked and indeterminate (mixed) states, a check or minus icon, focus ring and invalid styling, for forms and select-all lists. Not for: Settings that apply immediately (use switch).
- **collapsible** (Collapsible, CollapsibleTrigger, CollapsibleContent): A single disclosure panel with a generous trigger, visible open state, and reduced-motion-aware content transition. Not for: Several related disclosures; use accordion.
- **context-menu** (ContextMenu, ContextMenuTrigger, ContextMenuContent, ContextMenuGroup, ContextMenuItem, ContextMenuCheckboxItem, …): A right-click, long-press and Shift+F10 menu with submenus, checkbox and radio items, shortcut hints and a destructive style, built on Radix. Not for: The only way to reach an action; menus must be discoverable, so also offer a dropdown-menu button.
- **dialog** (Dialog, DialogClose, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogFooter, DialogHeader, …): A Radix modal dialog with a blurred overlay, centered card surface that fits 360 px screens, header and footer parts, optional close button and animations. Not for: Non-blocking messages (use a toast).
- **drawer** (Drawer, DrawerTrigger, DrawerClose, DrawerContent, DrawerHeader, DrawerBody, …): A swipe-to-dismiss panel from any edge on Vaul, with grab handle, header, scrollable body and footer, drag-safe inner content and reduced-motion handling. Not for: Desktop settings panels; use sheet.
- **dropdown-menu** (DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuTrigger, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuGroup, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuCheckboxItem, …): An action menu on a trigger with checkbox and radio items, submenus, shortcut hints and destructive rows, built on Radix for full keyboard and typeahead support. Not for: Choosing a form value; use select or combobox.
- **input** (Input, InputGroup, InputGroupAddon): A text input in three heights that match Button, plus InputGroup and InputGroupAddon for leading or trailing icons, units and domains. Not for: Multi-line text (use textarea).
- **kbd** (Kbd, KbdGroup): Keyboard key and shortcut display built on the semantic <kbd> element, in three sizes, with KbdGroup for combinations like ⌘ ⇧ K. Not for: Inline code or commands (use code).
- **label** (Label): An accessible form label built on Radix Label that dims itself when the paired peer control is disabled and never selects text on double-click. Not for: Headings or section titles (use a heading element).
- **media** (Media, isMediaImage): A picture slot: reserves the space, lazy-loads, takes a URL, an image with required alt text and a dark-mode file, or your own element, and falls back to artwork if… Not for: Icons (use an icon component).
- **popover** (Popover, PopoverTrigger, PopoverAnchor, PopoverContent, PopoverHeader, PopoverTitle, …): A focus-managed compact surface for controls or details, with collision handling, mobile-safe width, and optional close action. Not for: Long or critical forms; use dialog.
- **select** (Select, SelectContent, SelectGroup, SelectItem, SelectLabel, SelectScrollDownButton, …): A Radix select with a sized trigger, popper-positioned menu, scroll buttons, groups, labels, separators and a check indicator on the chosen item. Not for: Two or three options that should stay visible (use a radio group or segmented control).
- **sheet** (Sheet, SheetTrigger, SheetClose, SheetContent, SheetHeader, SheetBody, …): A modal panel that slides from any edge, with header, scrollable body and footer parts, a grab handle on bottom sheets, and safe-area padding. Not for: Short confirmations; use alert-dialog.
- **sortable** (Sortable, SortableGroup, SortableGroups, SortableHandle, SortableItem, SortableMove): Reorder lists, grids and multi-column boards by pointer, touch or keyboard, with spoken announcements, move buttons for people who cannot drag, a floating lifted item… Not for: A full kanban product with cards, tags and assignees; use kanban-board.
- **spring-drawer** (SpringDrawer, SpringDrawerTrigger, SpringDrawerContent, SpringDrawerHeader, SpringDrawerBody, SpringDrawerFooter, …): A drawer with spring physics: drag the handle to snap between heights or flick it closed, or slide in from the left or right, on Radix Dialog for focus trapping and… Not for: Simple modals (dialog).
- **switch** (Switch): A Radix toggle switch in two sizes with a CSS-animated thumb, for settings that take effect immediately. Not for: Choices submitted later with a form, or agreeing to terms (use checkbox).
- **textarea** (Textarea): A multi-line text field that can grow with its content between minRows and maxRows, then scroll. Not for: Single-line values (use input).
- **toggle** (Toggle): A compact two-state action with distinct pressed styling, visible keyboard focus, and outline or filled variants. Not for: Boolean form field; use switch.
- **toggle-group** (ToggleGroup, ToggleGroupItem): A compact roving-focus selection group for one or several pressed options, with clear states and mobile-friendly sizing. Not for: Unrelated actions; use button-group.
- **tooltip** (Tooltip, TooltipContent, TooltipProvider, TooltipTrigger): A Radix tooltip with an arrow, side offset and fade and zoom transitions that opens on hover and keyboard focus. Not for: Essential information or anything interactive (use a popover).
